modules.title: 依赖失败时，熔断器怎样阻止故障继续扩散
三种状态决定请求是否继续发送

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 依赖连续超时或失败会让调用方的等待和资源占用累积；达到条件后从 Closed 进入 Open，快速失败或降级，等待后只在 Half-Open 放少量请求探测。

items.title: 反馈决定恢复还是继续隔离
items.text: 探测成功才回到 Closed，探测失败则重新 Open。这样可观察的改善是调用方不再被拖满，但熔断器不会修复或保证依赖本身可用。

items.title: 第二个场景：天气查询
items.text: 行程页面依赖外部天气接口；连续失败时可暂时返回带更新时间的缓存预报并停止调用，稍后用少量请求探测，成功后再恢复正常查询。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 超时规定一次调用最多等多久，重试规定失败后再试几次；熔断器控制一段连续失败后是否暂时停止调用。它通常要和超时、有限重试及明确降级一起设计。

lessonPractice.title: 支付依赖已经连续失败，新的结算请求还在不断等待。熔断器下一步应该怎样做？

options.label: 进入 Open，快速失败或返回降级结果，稍后再以 Half-Open 探测
options.feedback: 对。打开状态先隔离故障，半开状态用有限探测判断依赖是否恢复。

options.label: 继续增加重试次数，让每个请求都等到支付成功
options.feedback: 无限重试会继续占用自己的资源；熔断器的作用正是停止把故障扩散到调用方。

options.label: 立即回到 Closed，并把所有新请求照常发送给失败依赖
options.feedback: 连续失败时立即关闭会重新放大故障，应该先打开并经过探测。

en.title: The payment dependency keeps failing while new checkout requests wait. What should the circuit breaker do next?

options.label: Enter Open, fail fast or degrade, then probe later in Half-Open
options.feedback: Correct. Open isolates the failure; Half-Open uses limited probes to learn whether the dependency recovered.

options.label: Keep increasing retries so every request waits for payment success
options.feedback: Unlimited retries consume caller resources; the breaker exists to stop the failure spreading.

options.label: Return to Closed immediately and send every new request to the failing dependency
options.feedback: Closing immediately would amplify the failure again; probe recovery before returning to normal calls.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 给支付依赖加熔断：正常时 Closed，连续失败后进入 Open，快速失败或返回明确的降级结果；等待后进入 Half-Open，只放少量探测请求，成功才恢复 Closed。模拟超时和恢复，验收状态变化、用户反馈和探测请求都可观察。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a circuit breaker around the payment dependency: stay Closed normally, enter Open after repeated failures with fast failure or a clear fallback, then move to Half-Open for a small recovery probe. Return to Closed only after success. Simulate timeouts and recovery, and verify the state, user feedback, and probe are observable.

learning.assumes: You have seen dependency timeouts, failed requests, or degraded service.
learning.outcome: You can use Closed, Open, and Half-Open to explain breaker behavior and distinguish it from timeout and retry.

modules.title: How a breaker stops a dependency failure from spreading
Three states decide whether calls continue

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: Repeated dependency timeouts or failures accumulate waiting and resource use at the caller; after crossing the threshold, the circuit breaker moves from Closed to Open for fast failure or fallback, then allows only a small probe in Half-Open after a pause.

items.title: Feedback decides recovery
items.text: A successful probe returns to Closed; a failed probe opens the circuit again. The caller is protected, but the breaker does not repair or guarantee the dependency.

items.title: A second scenario: weather lookup
items.text: A trip page depends on an external weather API. After repeated failures, it can temporarily return a cached forecast with its update time and stop calling the dependency, then use a few probes before restoring normal lookup.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A timeout sets how long one call waits, and a retry sets how many more attempts happen. A breaker decides whether repeated failure should temporarily stop calls. It usually works with bounded retries and an explicit fallback.
